verdict.rationale: Increase exposes a published OpenAPI spec, a CLI, LLM-readable docs, and an Events API with webhooks. Accounts and account numbers are managed programmatically, and payment lifecycle status, holds and returns are trackable, so an agent can read much of the picture without scraping the dashboard. However, the evidence never shows a transaction-listing or statement/document endpoint, and no MCP server is mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit transaction/pending-transaction read endpoints, document/statement access via API, an MCP surface, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent read access.
